title: Choose delegated ownership before a late fanout

rubric.text: Chooses delegated mode once at preflight because B and C form a later parallel point; assigns A as well as B and C to workers, rejecting per-frontier mode switching.
Accepts and integrates the worker-owned A commit and passes affected checks at that integrated head before releasing B and C.
Dispatches B and C concurrently within actual capacity in separate checkouts, preserving same-owner repair and mandatory independent final review.
